SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN "OpSecMetric" < 30 THEN 'Low OpSec'
    WHEN "OpSecMetric" < 60 THEN 'Medium OpSec'
    ELSE 'High OpSec'
  END as opsec_level,
  COUNT(*) as record_count,
  ROUND(AVG("ThreatIntelIndex")::numeric, 2) as avg_threat_intel,
  ROUND(AVG("DetectionAvoidance")::numeric, 2) as avg_detect_avoid,
  ROUND(AVG("PatternMatchScore")::numeric, 2) as avg_pattern_match,
  ROUND(AVG("BehaviorScore")::numeric, 2) as avg_behavior_score,
  ROUND(AVG("AnomalyValue")::numeric, 2) as avg_anomaly
FROM connection_security
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN "OpSecMetric" < 30 THEN 'Low OpSec'
    WHEN "OpSecMetric" < 60 THEN 'Medium OpSec'
    ELSE 'High OpSec'
  END
ORDER BY avg_threat_intel DESC

SELECT 
  "TxnPointer",
  "OpSecMetric",
  "ThreatIntelIndex",
  "DetectionAvoidance",
  "PatternMatchScore",
  "BehaviorScore",
  "ML_Confidence",
  "AnomalyValue",
  "FalsePosProb"
FROM connection_security
WHERE "ThreatIntelIndex" > 80 AND "DetectionAvoidance" > 70
ORDER BY ("ThreatIntelIndex" + "DetectionAvoidance") DESC
LIMIT 20
